paite: Nob a siampu Ahimelek kiang ah David ahong hi. Ahimelek in ling kawm in David ana dawn a, akiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia tangtat na chia, kuamah tonpih na neih louh?" achi hi.
heading: Saul A Pan David Ataimang
english: Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech came to meet David trembling, and said to him, “Why are you alone, and no man with you?”

paite: David in siampu Ahimelek kiang ah, "Kumpipa'n thilhih ding in thu ahon pia a, ka kiang ah, ka hon thilhihsak tup leh ka hon thupiak kuamah in thei kei heh, achi bikbek hi. Ka sikhate amun ding uh ka sehsakta," achi hi.
english: David said to Ahimelech the priest, “The king has commanded me to do something, and has said to me, ‘Let no one know anything about the business about which I send you, and what I have commanded you. I have sent the young men to a certain place.’

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, "Na khut ah bang a-om a? Tanghou beu nga ahihkeileh na neih lamlam hon pia in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore what is under your hand? Please give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatever is available.”

paite: Siampu in David adawng a, "Tanghou vantang ka nei kei a, himahleh tanghou siangthou bel ka nei hi, tangvalte numei a pan akihepkhiak nak uleh," achi hi.
english: The priest answered David, and said, “I have no common bread, but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept themselves from women.”

paite: David in siampu adawng a, akiang ah, "Tu ni thum sung numei a pan ka kihemkhe vek taktak uhi. Ka hong pawtkhiak dek lai in leng tangvalte tui-um belsuan asiangthou a, tanghou leng vantang ahi a, ahi, tuni tui-um belsuan sung asiansak mah bang in," achi hi.
english: David answered the priest, and said to him, “Truly, women have been kept from us as usual these three days. When I came out, the vessels of the young men were holy, though it was only a common journey. How much more then today shall their vessels be holy?”

paite: Huchi in siampu in tanghou siang- thou apeta hi. Huai ah lah tanghou koih alak ni ua tanghou lum a khen dia TOUPA ma a pan lak pen kia lou ngal tanghou dang a-om ngal kei hi.
english: So the priest gave him holy bread; for there was no bread there but the show bread that was taken from before Yahweh, to be replaced with hot bread in the day when it was taken away.

paite: Huai ni in Saul sikhate lak a mi khat TOUPA ma a zekaisak a-om a; amin Doeg ahi. Amah Edom mi, Saul ganchingmi lak a heutupen ahi.
english: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before Yahweh; and his name was Doeg the Edomite, the best of the herdsmen who belonged to Saul.

paite: David in Ahimelek kiang ah, "Teipi hiam, namsau hiam na kem kei maw? Kumpipa hon sawlna thukin ahih ziak in ka namsau leh ka galvan bangmah ka hon tawi man kei hi,” achi hi.
english: David said to Ahimelech, “Isn’t there here under your hand spear or sword? For I haven’t brought my sword or my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.”

paite: Siampu in, “Philistia mi Goliath, Elah Phaizang a na thahpa namsau, ngai in, siampu puanak nung ah puan a tuam in a-om hi. Huai na laknopleh la in. Huai lou ngal adang a-om kei," achi hi. David in, "Huai val a-om ding hia, hon pe dih ve," achi hi.
english: The priest said, “Behold, the sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the valley of Elah, is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you would like to take that, take it, for there is no other except that here.” David said, “There is none like that. Give it to me.”

paite: Huchi in David adingh a, huai ni in Saul lau in ataimang a, Gath kumpipa Akish kiang ah apaita hi.
english: David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

paite: Akish sikhate'n akiang ah, "Hiai mi huai gam kumpipa David ahi kei maw? Saul in asang asang athat, David in asing asing, chih lou kawm in atungtang la in asa zuazua uh ahi kei maw?" achi uhi.
english: The servants of Achish said to him, “Isn’t this David the king of the land? Didn’t they sing to one another about him in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”

paite: David in huai thute alungsim in apai a, Gath kumpipa Akish alau mahmah hi.
english: David laid up these words in his heart, and was very afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

paite: Huchi in ama ah a-omdan ahihlamdang a, amitmuh un akihaisak hi. Akhut in kongkhakte aham ekek a, akhamul ah achil aluangsak zengzung hi.
english: He changed his behavior before them and pretended to be insane in their hands, and scribbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down on his beard.

paite: Huchi in Akish in asikhate kiang ah, "Enta unla, mihai ahih na thei ua, bangziak a ka kiang a hon pi na hi ua?
english: Then Achish said to his servants, “Look, you see the man is insane. Why then have you brought him to me?

paite: Mihai ka kitaksap ziak in hia hiai mi ahaidan hihlang dia ka ma a na hon pi uh? Hiai mi ka inn ah ahong lut tel mahmah ding maw?" achi hi.
english: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Should this fellow come into my house?”
